pokedexEntries.di: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

pokedexEntries.prl: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

pokedexEntries.pt: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
